in_text_mentions: The ultrasound study showed dynamic instability of the acromioclavicular (AC), without tendon lesions or other pathological findings of soft parts. Computed axial tomography (CT) showed a superior subluxation of 5 mm (Figure 2) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) showed the integrity of the conoid and trapezoid ligaments (Figure 3).
